title: capi: pattern match for bitcoinkernel library
body:
Hardcoding the library extensions is fragile. For example, the library can be installed with a version number: `libbitcoinkernel.so`, `libbitcoinkernel.so.0`, `libbitcoinkernel.so.0.1`, etc are all valid library names.

Instead, use pattern match based on the name containing "bitcoinkernel" and throw a RuntimeError if multiple installations are found in the `_libs/` directory.

I think this fixes #13 - cc @josibake.
author: stickies-v

comments.body: @josibake I'm going to go ahead and merge this already because it's an improvement regardless of your issue. If it doesn't fully address your issue, definitely let me know and we can continue the conversation in #13?
